description: Source code for the BidiChromium class, which extends BrowserType to manage Chromium browser instances with support for Chromium DevTools Protocol and Bidi over CDP, including connection handling, startup configuration, and environment management.

classes.name: BidiChromium
classes.description: Class extending BrowserType to support Chromium with Bidi over CDP, managing connection, startup args, environment, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the browser transport, wrapping it with Bidi over CDP, and handles errors related to profile usage.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to include ASCII box errors or sandboxing failure messages.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for the browser process; currently returns the environment unchanged.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a close message to the browser via transport, reusing the Bidi over CDP transport if available.

methods.name: supportsPipeTransport
methods.description: Indicates whether pipe transport is supported; returns false.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Chromium, including user data dir, debugging port, and headless options.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready, returning WebSocket endpoint info.

methods.name: _innerDefaultArgs
methods.description: Constructs the list of default command-line arguments based on options, including sandbox, proxy, and headless settings.

methods.name: getExecutableName
methods.description: Returns the executable name based on the specified channel, supporting different Chromium channels.
